description: Frozen independent synthetic reliability evaluation using only the unchanged supplied builtin, Python package and seven fixture references. Measures evidence retrieval, not authentic incidents or fix resolution.

provenance.selection: Independently selected before the next ranking implementation; no predictions or ranking implementation inspected. Includes wrappers, path/identifier noise, single-line free queries, qualified IDs, multiple relevant sources, mixed diagnostics and supported/unsupported boundaries. Frozen labels must not be tuned to observed outcomes.
provenance.limits: 24 deliberately varied synthetic cases sharing the existing small corpus; zero authentic incident logs. Shared source IDs and diagnostic families are intentional; normalized queries are disjoint from both exposed regression sets. Semantic overlap with known diagnostic families does not establish real-world generalization.
